sources.title: OpenKanban README
sources.finding: TUI kanban board; each ticket gets its own git worktree and embedded terminal; agents OpenCode, Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, Aider or any CLI; multi-project; Homebrew and go install; AGPL-3.0.

sources.title: Configuration guide
sources.finding: config.json defaults, agents map (command, args, env, init_prompt), branch naming, cleanup, behavior, ui, themes, OpenCode server and Claude status integration via oh-my-claude, labels and priority, keybindings.

sources.title: Agent integration guide
sources.finding: Agents run in embedded PTY terminals; spawn requires In Progress; context-prompt injection; session continuation flags; status detection; environment filtering; no input from users reaches the command line.

sources.title: AGPL-3.0 licence text
sources.finding: GNU Affero General Public License version 3 text; README and GitHub metadata state AGPL-3.0; no "or any later version" grant added to the README.

sources.title: Ticket data model
sources.finding: Ticket has ID, ProjectID, Title, Description, Status backlog/in_progress/done/archived, UseWorktree, WorktreePath, BranchName, BaseBranch, AgentType, AgentStatus, AgentSessionID, timestamps, Labels, Priority, Meta, BlockedBy (comment: informational only, no enforcement).

sources.title: Default columns
sources.finding: Three columns Backlog, In Progress (Limit 3) and Done.

sources.title: Column count and limit rendering
sources.finding: Column header shows (n/limit) and styles the count when the limit is reached; no enforcement code found elsewhere (grep ".Limit" matches only board.go and view.go).

sources.title: Ticket store persistence
sources.finding: Tickets persist as per-project JSON under the config directory tickets/ (atomic tmp+rename write); migration from legacy repo-local .openkanban/tickets.json.

sources.title: Global ticket store
sources.finding: GlobalTicketStore aggregates all projects for the single board; blocker reference cleanup on delete.

sources.title: Root and project commands
sources.finding: Cobra root runs the TUI (flags --config, --project); subcommands new, list, delete (projects only).

sources.title: Config subcommands
sources.finding: config validate, generate, path.

sources.title: App startup and project creation
sources.finding: Starts opencode server only when the default agent is opencode; update checker created; CreateProject rejects a path without .git ("not a git repository"); ListProjects counts tickets.

sources.title: spawnAgent
sources.finding: Spawn requires the ticket In Progress ("Press Space to move to In Progress first"), blocks a second agent on the same ticket and a second main-repo agent in a project, resolves ticket agent type or default, starts the opencode server on demand.

sources.title: prepareSpawn
sources.finding: Creates the worktree (git worktree add) or sets up a branch in the main repo, creates PTY pane in the worktree, injects the context prompt for new sessions, adds --continue/--session/--resume/resume flags for claude, opencode, gemini and codex on later spawns, allocates a per-ticket opencode port.

sources.title: quickMoveTicket
sources.finding: Space moves a ticket to the next column and creates the worktree when it first enters In Progress; no dependency or limit check before the move.

sources.title: Ticket delete cleanup
sources.finding: Delete stops the pane, optionally removes the worktree (cleanup.delete_worktree) and branch (delete_branch), warns on uncommitted changes unless force_worktree_removal, removes blocker references.

sources.title: Quit handling
sources.finding: Quitting with running agents asks for confirmation (behavior.confirm_quit_with_agents) and then stops them.

sources.title: Cleanup on exit
sources.finding: Cleanup() gracefully stops every running pane (interrupt then kill after timeout).

sources.title: Blocker selection UI
sources.finding: Ticket form field for BlockedBy with filter and sorted candidates; selected blockers saved on the ticket.

sources.title: Dependency badge
sources.finding: Card shows blocked-by and blocks counts as a badge.

sources.title: Search filter
sources.finding: Search matches title and description, supports @project prefix; project sidebar filter.

sources.title: Status detection
sources.finding: Statuses idle/working/waiting/completed/error detected from the OpenCode HTTP API, status files under ~/.cache/openkanban-status and terminal-text pattern matching.

sources.title: Status file read/write
sources.finding: Reads and writes JSON status files per session name; stale files cleaned on spawn.

sources.title: Status polling
sources.finding: Polls agent statuses on a timer and updates ticket cards; panes that exit are reset.

sources.title: PTY pane lifecycle
sources.finding: Starts the agent command under creack/pty in the ticket worktree, vt10x terminal emulation, Stop kills the process, StopGraceful interrupts then kills.

sources.title: Agent environment
sources.finding: Strips OPENCODE_*, CLAUDE_*, GEMINI_*, CODEX_* variables, sets TERM and OPENKANBAN_SESSION for the child.

sources.title: Worktree manager
sources.finding: git worktree add -b branch path base under <repo>-worktrees; list and remove; default branch from origin/HEAD or main/master.

sources.title: Branch and status helpers
sources.finding: GetDefaultBranch, DeleteBranch, SetupBranch, HasUncommittedChanges (git status --porcelain).

sources.title: Project model
sources.finding: One project per git repository with worktree dir default <repo>-worktrees and per-project branch settings.

sources.title: Config structure
sources.finding: Config sections defaults, agents (command, args, env, status_file, init_prompt), ui, cleanup, behavior, opencode.

sources.title: Effective init prompt
sources.finding: Agent-specific init_prompt, then defaults.init_prompt, then built-in prompt.

sources.title: Context prompt builder
sources.finding: Go text/template with Title, Description, BranchName, BaseBranch, TicketID, Status, WorktreePath.

sources.title: OpenCode server manager
sources.finding: Starts opencode serve on the configured port (reusing a running server) and polls its HTTP endpoint.

sources.title: Update check
sources.finding: GET https://api.github.com/repos/TechDufus/openkanban/releases/latest on start (skipped for dev builds); shows a notice with the brew or go install hint; no config key to disable.

sources.title: Update check wiring
sources.finding: Init() runs checkForUpdates and notifies when a newer release exists.

sources.title: In-app settings
sources.finding: Settings menu edits theme, default agent, confirm quit, branch prefix, cleanup flags, sidebar and project filter and writes config.json.

sources.title: GoReleaser build matrix
sources.finding: Builds linux, darwin and windows on amd64 and arm64; tar.gz archives and windows zip; checksums.txt.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 155 stars at the check; AGPL-3.0 detected; default branch main; last push 2026-06-12; not archived; no homepage.

sources.title: Release v0.1.1
sources.finding: v0.1.1 published 2026-06-12 (commit 02201ed, one bug-fix commit); assets: darwin, linux and windows archives for amd64 and arm64 plus checksums.txt; install via Homebrew or go install.

sources.title: Repository issues
sources.finding: Open issues #104 (card height clipping), #102 (agent pane index), #95 (text selection in terminal pane); closed feature issue #103 (per-ticket markdown storage and hot reload) is not part of the pinned v0.1.1 source (no markdown storage code found); no roadmap issue.

sources.title: README demo recording
sources.finding: First-party vhs recording of the TUI on synthetic tickets (Add user authentication, Setup database schema, Build REST API endpoints) with OpenCode working and idle states.

sources.title: Bounded search: network, servers, remote clients
sources.finding: net/http appears only in internal/update/update.go (GitHub releases API), internal/agent/server.go and status.go (HTTP client to a local OpenCode server on localhost); no listener, web server, mobile client, SSH, container, VM, cloud, login or OAuth code.

sources.title: Bounded search: PR, CI, merge, deploy, diff
sources.finding: git is used only for worktree add/remove/list, branch create/delete, status --porcelain and default-branch detection; no commit, push, PR, merge, rebase, diff viewer, CI or deploy code. GitHub API used only for the release check.

sources.title: Bounded search: MCP, plugins, skills, webhooks, scheduling
sources.finding: No MCP client or server, plugin loader, skill import, webhook, scheduler or cron code; the only timers are render throttling, status polling and notification expiry.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost, tokens, usage, limits
sources.finding: cost:/tokens: appear only as substrings matched in agent terminal text for status heuristics (status.go); no usage accounting, spend or token limit; timeouts only for HTTP polling and opencode startup (default 10s).

sources.title: Bounded search: collaboration, roles, approvals, audit
sources.finding: No multi-user, role, permission, approval gate, audit log or sharing code; state is single-user JSON under the config directory.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry and export/import
sources.finding: No telemetry or analytics; no export/import command (tickets are plain JSON files under ~/.config/openkanban/tickets).
